title: Comparisons of Two Types of Rehabilitation Robot for Upper Extremities
brief_summary: Comparisons of two types of rehabilitation robot for upper extremities: 3 dimension exoskeleton type upper extremity robot vs. 2 dimension end-effector type robot)
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Hemiplegic patients secondary to first cerebrovascular accidents
* Onset ≥ 3 months
* 8 ≤ Fugl-Meyer Assessment score ≤ 30
* Shoulder or elbow flexor spasticity modified ashworth scale ≤ 3
* Cognitively intact enough to understand and follow the instructions from the investigator

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of surgery of affected upper limb
* Fracture of affected upper limb
